Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.model

Class UnidadDTO

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.model.UnidadDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class UnidadDTO extends Object implements Serializable
The class UnidadDTO represents a unit in the game. This class contains attributes that define the characteristics of a unit, such as life, attack, defense, experience and type.
Author:
Bustamante Castellanos Caren Sofia, Hospital Herrera Dylan Mathyus, Ramirez Chacon Alejandra Valenttina, Ruiz Cruz Gabriel Alejandro, Triana Mejia Juan Diego, Vela Cardozo German Octavio
